IpAllowlist._comment: C3 fix: Admin endpoints (/api/users, /api/roles, /api/workflow, /api/audit-logs) are restricted to these IPs. Add your office/VPN IPs here. Supports individual IPs and CIDR ranges. Empty array = all admin endpoints return 403.

LoanProductSync._comment: How often the LoanProductSyncHostedService runs to pull webloan's loan_product catalog into the ALAS mirror. Default 360 minutes (6h) — policy changes are infrequent, this is a mirror, not a transactional job.

TokenCleanup._comment: How often CleanupExpiredTokensHostedService runs to bulk-delete expired RefreshTokens (sliding + absolute expiry) and RevokedTokens (JTI blacklist past access-token expiry). Default 60 minutes (1h). The hot table is RevokedTokens — every logout adds a row that becomes eligible for delete 15 minutes later; 1h means worst case ~4× per-hour churn sits in the table, well within indexed-seek range.

WorkflowSlaHours._comment: Handling SLA hours per workflow stage. The /api/loans/sla-policy endpoint serves these to the frontend. Terminal stages (Approved, Rejected, Disbursed) intentionally absent — no one owes an action there.

Workflow._comment: Feature flags controlling the loan workflow pipeline shape. Hot-reloadable via IOptionsMonitor — flip without redeploy. Env-var override: Workflow__RequireRecommendation=false

Queue._comment: Review Desk queue tuning. Hot-reloadable via IOptionsMonitor. LeaseTtlMinutes = minutes before an idle lease is considered abandoned and stealable by the next reviewer.

Garnet._comment: Garnet cache client tuning. These settings control the StackExchange.Redis client behavior when connecting to Garnet. Adjust based on workload profile and server capacity.
